case_number: Civil Appeal No(s). 297-298 of 2022 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No(s). 1940-1941 of 2020)

parties.petitioner: The Punjab State Cooperative Agricultural Development Bank Ltd.
parties.respondent: The Registrar, Cooperative Societies and Others

summary: Dispute over viability and continuation of pension scheme for employees of Punjab State Cooperative Agricultural Development Bank Ltd. Employees had opted for pension scheme introduced w.e.f. 1.4.1989 under amended Rules 1978. Bank discontinued full pension benefits in 2010 citing financial constraints, stopping commutation, medical reimbursement, and LTC. High Court upheld employees' right to pension benefits. Supreme Court examined statutory basis of pension scheme, validity of withdrawal, and obligations under Rules 1978 and prior approvals. Issue: whether Bank could unilaterally alter pension benefits after employees opted into scheme.
legal_provisions_cited: Punjab State Cooperative Agricultural Land Mortgage Banks Service (Common Cadre) Rules, 1978
Employees Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
Punjab Civil Services Rules, Vol. II
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; Court held that employees who opted into pension scheme are entitled to accrued pension benefits; Bank cannot unilaterally withdraw commutation, medical, and LTC without regulatory or statutory basis; directions issued for revival and proper funding of pension scheme in accordance with law and rules.
